{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales_df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter data for only email and paid_search channels
campaign_data = sales_df[sales_df['channel'].isin(['email', 'paid_search'])]

# Check the distribution of customer_segment across channels
segment_by_channel = pd.crosstab(campaign_data['channel'], campaign_data['customer_segment'])

# Compute conversion rates for each channel
conversion_rates = campaign_data.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Compute the difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search)
difference_in_rates = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Round the difference to 4 decimal places for reporting
rounded_difference = round(difference_in_rates, 4)

# Print results
print("Cross-tabulation of customer_segment by channel:\n", segment_by_channel)
print("\nConversion rates:\n", conversion_rates)
print("\nDifference in conversion rates (email - paid_search):", rounded_difference)"}
